name: Jos. Doulisch
role: Laborer fatally injured in a foundation cave-in at Medora
bio: Jos. Doulisch was badly hurt in March 1884 when earth fell on him while he was excavating next to Michael Knott's saloon for a new building. He seemed to be recovering, but the paper reported his death in early April 1884.
